// diagnostic

E0740

`{fn}` uses the effect `{effect}`, which its signature doesn't allow.

What

`{fn}` uses the effect `{effect}`, which its signature doesn't allow.

Why

A `-[…]>` list is an upper bound on what the body may do; the inferred effects must be a subset. An effect the body reaches that the bound omits breaks that contract.

Fix

Add the named effect to the `-[…]>` list, or stop using it (drop the Core call that introduces it, or move it out of this function).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0740: tests/ui/E0740_live_query_writes.stderr.

Error [E0740]: `bump` uses the effect `DB.Write`, which a live query doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/E0740_live_query_writes.jet:10:25
    |
 10 |     binding :: app.live(bump, 1)
    |                         ^^^^
 Why: `live` re-runs its query whenever the data it read changes, so the query may only read the database
 Fix: Keep the query to `-[DB.Read]>`, or use `subscribe` for another source
